title: *.bundle.json / *.bundle.yaml
description: One bundle generated by `tic build` (@ts-ioc-container/bundler). `tic build` builds every `*.bundle.json` / `*.bundle.yaml` / `*.bundle.yml` at the root of the package it is invoked in, or — with none — one bundle from that package's tsconfig.json with every setting at its default. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory.

extends.description: The tsconfig this bundle extends, as a tsconfig's own `extends`: its file set, `paths` aliases and module resolution apply unless this file overrides them. Relative to this file. The default may be absent; a tsconfig named here must exist.

output.description: The bundle file (convention: *.bundle.ts). Default `<root>/<name>.bundle.ts`: <root> is the compiled rootDir, else the common folder of the files compiled.

name.description: The bundle's name: letters, digits, "-" and "_", starting with a letter. Default: this file's stem (production.bundle.json → production), else "base". It names the default output (production.bundle.ts) and the generated IContainerModule class (ProductionBundle).

include.description: tsconfig `include`: replaces the extended tsconfig's. Relative to this file.

exclude.description: tsconfig `exclude`: replaces the extended tsconfig's. Relative to this file.

importExtension.description: Extension of generated imports, e.g. ".js". Inferred from the tsconfig: ".js" under node16/nodenext resolution, none otherwise.

decorators.description: The class must carry one of these decorators, recognised by name (e.g. "register", or a composed decorator). Default ["register"]; [] requires none.

name.description: Glob the class name must match, e.g. "*Service". An anonymous default export is named after its file.

excludeClasses.description: Class names to drop after selection, e.g. one test double sitting next to the real registration in the same file.

excludeName.description: Glob the class name must NOT match, e.g. "*Mock". An anonymous default export is named after its file.

classes.description: Which classes of a scanned file are registered. A class is selected when it is exported, not abstract, and meets every criterion set here; by default that is every exported class decorated with @register.

paths.description: tsconfig `paths`: aliases the generated imports are written in.

rootDir.description: tsconfig `rootDir`: where the default output (<rootDir>/<name>.bundle.ts) goes.

compilerOptions.description: tsconfig `compilerOptions`, plus the bundler's own `importExtension` and `classes`. Every other option is handed to TypeScript on top of the extended tsconfig's, which validates it.
